claims: The Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team has won two NCAA Division I National Championships.
The Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team's most recent NCAA Division I National Championship was in 2026.
Dusty May was the head coach of the Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team during the 2026 national championship.
The Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team defeated UConn 69-63 in the 2026 title game.
The 2026 title game was in Indianapolis.
The Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team won their first championship in 37 years in 2026.
The Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team's first national title was won in 1989.
